title: mine-lite (VV)
description: Easy assembly of mods for the latest version of Minecraft, balance between the number of mods and performance.
body: This modpack is a lighter replacement for Optifine or Fabulously Optimized. Its feature is that it does not have unnecessary mods but gives a big FPS boost. This build is suitable for running on a weak PC, running shaders and as a basis for large mod builds.
